description: A woman in a black abaya and face veil (niqab) and black head covering leans over a clear plastic box, feeding a white paper ballot into its slot. Behind her, a seated woman in black writes at a wooden desk, and several veiled women stand in a line at the right and back. The scene is dim and painterly, with dark brown and grey tones and warm light on the figures. No visible text, frame or border; the painting fills the canvas edge to edge.
